9100001.translation: Climbed the north-west face below the ridge. Around 2,400 m, cracks shot out from under our skis and there was a clear 'whumpf' as we crossed. Heavy build-up of wind-blown snow below the ridge. We turned back at about 2,500 m.

9100002.translation: Good conditions up to 2,000 m, powder in the open forest. Wind-packed higher up, no warning signs noticed.

9100003.translation: Hard, crusty snow on the ridge. Saw a small natural release on the north face.

plan.input: Tomorrow at 8 with Nikos. I'm wearing a red jacket, back at the car by 2.
